description: Ministry of Defence - Constitute and create the Meritorious Service Medal and a medal as reward of service
categorisation: This gazette establishes the Meritorious Service Medal through a presidential proclamation and detailed regulations. It creates a new legal framework for military awards, specifying eligibility criteria, design, forfeiture rules, and administrative procedures. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
